name: ShutdownHost
transaction_boundary: no new authoritative UnitOfWork may begin after QUIESCING; already-active units finish or roll back within bounded shutdown policy
guards: request run/data identity equals current authenticated run
host is READY or LISTENING_NOT_READY or already QUIESCING
command_id replay is equal if previously committed
idempotency: COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1 for same run/data/command; repeated committed shutdown returns ALREADY_QUIESCING without duplicate persistent evidence
receipt_order: revalidate run/control state -> insert command receipt when database is available/current -> append foundation.runtime_shutdown_requested.v1 -> commit -> set/continue QUIESCING technical state
mutations: Foundation command receipt/audit when authoritative DB is available
revision_effects: no domain revision; runtime state READY|LISTENING_NOT_READY -> QUIESCING once
post_commit_work: stop new background work, boundedly drain active units, checkpoint WAL TRUNCATE, close keyed connections/executors/socket, remove only exact-owned registry, release instance lock
